correctness.rationale: The pair-subset permutation character subtracts the natural character to give chi_A=F(F-3)/2+C_2. Exterior square of the standard module gives chi_B=(F-1)(F-2)/2-C_2. Degrees d_A=n(n-3)/2, d_B=(n-1)(n-2)/2 differ by one, so their weighted sum is the exact central kernel K=d_A F(F-3)/2+d_B(F-1)(F-2)/2-C_2. For F=1,2 it equals -d_A-C_2<0; for F=0 or 3 it equals d_B-C_2>0 (all n>=4), and for F>=4 all positive. Both characters have zero group mean. Count marked transpositions among permutations with r=1 or 2 fixed points using choose(n,r)choose(n-r,2)D_{n-r-2} and derangement inclusion-exclusion to derive norm=(3(n^2-3n+1)/2)E_{n-2}+(-1)^(n-2)(5-n^2)/(2(n-1)!). Alternating-series bounds prove 3/(2e); at the identity the complementary kernel is positive because other irreducibles exist. Independent exhaustive enumeration for 4<=n<=8 covered 46,224 permutations, all signs/zero mass and exact norms (e.g. n=4 17/6, n=5 71/12, n=8 114053/5040). Finite checks corroborate the character proof.
